description: Curated tutorial source registry. Each entry is a real YouTube tutorial for a named trick, used to build the grounded trick knowledge base. Quality-filtered by hand: prefers channels with clear step-by-step verbal instruction over pure visual demos, because the pipeline mines the TRANSCRIPT, not the video.
selection_criteria: Channel/creator is an established yoyo tutorial source (YoTricks, YoYoExpert, AT YoYo Superstar, The Yoyo Bro, Dylan Kowalski, etc.)
Transcript is available (auto-captions count) - the pipeline is transcript-driven
Video walks through the trick verbally (mount names, hand positions, tips, common mistakes)
Deprioritised: pure slow-mo demos / music-only edits with no narration

styles.1A: Single-handed string tricks (the dominant modern style)
